prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Big Data Analytics With MLlib and PySpark
You will perform Big Data Analytics using Apache Spark. The objective is to 'perform Sentiment Analysis on a given brand of choice and provide useful recommendations that can help us grow the business'. You can pick any of the big brands in the league of Samsung, Toyota, Barclays, Unilever, etc. Summary of Deliverables 1. Stream Tweets pertaining to the customer opinions regarding the selected brand 2. Perform pre-processing and visualizations in Spark 3. Use Spark MLlib to build a model for business improvement. For example, identify patterns in the data and recommend that customers of this type were generally happy about this and that. 4. Give the codes and accuracy scores 5. Zero payment for plagiarized codes You are guaranteed 5-stars to help build and promoting your profile.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Call centre speech analytics
client: Vantor Call Centers
client_industry: customer service
start: 2024-10
end: 2025-01
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python
- Whisper
- pyannote
- OpenAI API
- PostgreSQL
implied_skills:
- speaker diarization
built: A pipeline that transcribes calls, separates agent and customer, and writes
  a QA summary for every call.
metrics:
- word error rate 11.8%
- 2,300 hours processed
- QA coverage from 3% to 100% of calls

Style:
- Open by briefly introducing yourself.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Call centre speech analytics (p14).
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience in Python, NLP, and model development. I can help you build a Spark-based sentiment analysis workflow that streams tweets, preprocesses and visualizes the data in Spark, and uses MLlib to generate business recommendations.

On a recent project, I built a call centre speech analytics pipeline for Vantor Call Centers using Python, Whisper, pyannote, OpenAI API, and PostgreSQL. It transcribed calls, separated agent and customer speech, and generated QA summaries for every call, achieving 11.8% word error rate and processing 2,300 hours of audio.

For your project, I can deliver clean code, accuracy scores, and clear insights tied to the chosen brand. Which brand would you like me to analyze: Samsung, Toyota, Barclays, Unilever, or another?
